newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in slow activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in slow activity.

text.p: Spot millfeed prices were mixed on Tuesday in subdued holiday activity, dealers said.
Dealers in the Carolinas, Missouri and Texas noted just a few nearby trades and very little forward trading.
"There was no forward trade at all, just a few truckloads for nearbys," a Carolinas dealer said.
"People are waiting to see what farmers will do after the first of the year and how much volume we will pick up," a broker said.
